draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks for the reply, and for raising dark mode — your ticket is still open with us. To set expectations: dark mode isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap.

After our kickoff, the natural next step is your first project — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help get that first project shaped with you?

Best,
Priya
